milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find fire' is a locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the fire blocks and face them to demonstrate they've found them. Fire is at spawn-relative center ~(4.5, 1, 4.5). Target set to (5, 1, 5) with max_distance=8 and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the player is close enough and looking at the fire. This is preferred over position_inside_box for find/observe tasks per milestone design guidelines.

Uses inventory_has because mining a crimson_stem block causes it to drop itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with only a diamond_axe (no crimson_stem in starting inventory), so having ≥1 crimson_stem in inventory is definitive proof of successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly reflects the outcome.
